photo.alt: Kevin Nicol playing Don Henley’s guitar backstage
photo.title: Don Henley’s Custom Guitar
photo.caption: 2008 — Qwest Center Omaha, Omaha, Nebraska — Eagles Arena Tour (I.A.T.S.E. Local 42): During a backstage break on the Eagles arena call ahead of the 2008 CMA Awards, one of Don Henley's guitar techs let me play Henley's custom-built guitar for a minute and offered to snap this photo. I held a B-minor chord as a joke—the opening chord of 'Hotel California.'
